title: Docs link checker: decode HTML entities before deriving heading slugs
outcome: scripts/check-doc-links.mjs derives heading anchors as GitHub renders them when headings contain HTML entities.
acceptance: A heading such as '# Fish & chips' is accepted under its GitHub anchor #fish--chips and #fish-amp-chips is reported as unresolved, proven by a synthetic fixture test in scripts/check-doc-links.test.mjs.
